name: Chaliyar

source.name: Elambaleri Hills, Western Ghats, near Cherambadi

significance: fourth-longest river in Kerala, flowing through Nilambur, Areekode and Feroke before Beypore
historically important for the timber trade at Beypore, one of India's oldest ports
did_you_know: The Chaliyar is known as the Beypore River in its final stretch, giving the historic port town of Beypore its name.

The traced channel's length (111km) falls well short of the ~169km commonly quoted for the Chaliyar, consistent across two independently-anchored traces — a real gap between HydroRIVERS' modelled course and the cited figure, not a tracing error.
